themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain and Italy are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social benefits and services. This theme has seen strong convergence with similar legislative efforts in multiple regions, particularly in Spain where Vox has successfully influenced coalition agreements with the PP to implement these policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has successfully negotiated 'national priority' policies in coalition agreements with the PP in Castilla y León and Andalusia, requiring proof of residency for regional benefits.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega's Matteo Salvini has faced backlash for adopting similar rhetoric, particularly around migration policies, though internal divisions persist.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella has emphasized national sovereignty in social policies, aligning with the broader 'national priority' framework.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: The party has pushed for policies that prioritize Swedish citizens in welfare access, echoing the 'national priority' theme.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage has advocated for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing British citizens in social services, aligning with the broader theme.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei continues to face declining approval ratings and internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza. The theme is marked by public protests, legislative setbacks, and tensions with allies, reflecting broader dissatisfaction with his economic policies and leadership style.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's approval ratings have dropped significantly, with protests against his austerity measures and internal conflicts within his party escalating.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing media has drawn parallels between Milei's challenges and those faced by other populist leaders, including internal divisions.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish right-wing media has criticized Milei's economic policies, highlighting his declining popularity as a cautionary tale for populist movements.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe have made significant gains in recent local elections, consolidating their influence in regional governments. This theme highlights the growing electoral success of parties like Vox in Spain, Lega in Italy, and AfD in Germany, often through coalition agreements with mainstream conservative parties.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD has made gains in local elections, particularly in eastern Germany, where it has become a significant political force.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega has secured victories in local elections, particularly in northern Italy, often through coalition agreements with Fratelli d'Italia.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has expanded its influence in regional governments through coalition agreements with the PP, particularly in Castilla y León and Andalusia.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: The party has made gains in local elections, particularly in southern Sweden, where it has become a key player in municipal governments.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has made inroads in local elections, particularly in areas with high immigration, where it has gained seats from both Labour and the Conservatives.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, often centered around leadership disputes, ideological differences, and strategic disagreements. This theme highlights the growing fractures within parties like Poland's PiS, Hungary's Fidesz, and Italy's Lega, which threaten their cohesion and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal divisions over leadership and policy direction, particularly regarding its stance on Ukraine and judicial reforms.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz is experiencing internal strife following its electoral defeat, with factions vying for control and influence within the party.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK is grappling with internal divisions over its stance on immigration and economic policies, with some members defecting to the Conservatives.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces internal divisions over its leadership and alliance with Fratelli d'Italia, with some members advocating for a more independent stance.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: The party is divided over leadership and policy direction, particularly regarding its stance on immigration and economic policies.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders across the globe are reacting to escalating conflicts in the Middle East, particularly between Israel and Iran. This theme highlights their support for Israel, criticism of Iran, and the broader geopolitical implications of these conflicts for domestic and international policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump has taken a strong stance on Middle East conflicts, particularly in supporting Israel and criticizing Iran, which has resonated with his base.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei has aligned Argentina closely with Israel, reflecting his pro-Israel stance and criticism of Iran.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties have expressed strong support for Israel, with Salvini and Meloni criticizing Iran's actions in the region.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has taken a pro-Israel stance, criticizing Iran and supporting Israel's right to defend itself.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: The party has expressed support for Israel while criticizing Iran's role in the Middle East conflicts.
